scope: Remaining Windows narrowing call-site source audit; no new socket execution or whole platform qualification claim

Reactor interest count<=1024 and declared/output capacity bounds before WSAPoll count conversion.

findings: Windows environment lookup has no name_len Int32 bound before scanning and truncation.

apiReferenceSummary: Zero is failure; error203 identifies an absent variable. Other failure codes must not be promoted to a present empty value. Preserve genuine empty result behavior with explicit last-error reset/classification.
